data.name: ErrNeedPodParent
data.value: Say which plant the pod grew on, or type a name.
data.comment: Error when saving a cross with no pod parent.

data.name: ErrNeedPollenParent
data.value: Say which plant the pollen came from, or type a name.
data.comment: Error when saving a cross with no pollen parent.

data.name: ErrFuture
data.comment: Error when the day of a pollination or of collecting seed is in the future.

data.name: ErrRipeBeforePollinated
data.value: The seed can't be ripe before the flower was pollinated.
data.comment: Error when the day the seed was ripe is before the day of the pollination.

data.name: ErrCount
data.value: Flowers and pods have to be whole numbers, with at least one flower.
data.comment: Error when the number of flowers pollinated or pods set is not a sensible whole number.

data.name: ErrLotNeedsName
data.value: Say what the seed is, where it came from or which cross it is from.
data.comment: Error when saving a seed lot that has no name, source or cross.

data.name: ErrAmount
data.value: The amount has to be more than nothing.
data.comment: Error when the amount of seed is zero, negative or very large.

data.name: AmountGrams
data.comment: An amount of seed in grams. {0} is the number.

data.name: AmountSeeds_One
data.comment: An amount of seed counted in seeds, exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: AmountSeeds_Other
data.comment: An amount of seed counted in seeds, any other number. {0} is the number.

data.name: AmountAbout
data.comment: A rough amount of seed. {0} is the amount, like 100 seeds or 1 g.

data.name: ParentGone
data.value: a plant you no longer have
data.comment: Name of a parent of a cross when the plant is gone and no name was kept.

data.name: TitleOf
data.comment: Title of a cross. {0} is the pod parent and {1} the pollen parent.

data.name: TitleSelf
data.comment: Title of a cross where the same plant is both parents. {0} is the plant.

data.name: LotUnnamed
data.comment: Name of a seed lot that has no name, source or cross to call it by.

data.name: NameAndTitle
data.comment: A cross with a working name, followed by its title. {0} is the working name and {1} the parents.

data.name: ErrPollenNeedsPlant
data.value: Say which plant the pollen came from, or type a name.
data.comment: Error when saving pollen with no plant or name.

data.name: ErrUsedBeforeCollected
data.value: It cannot be used up before it was collected.
data.comment: Error when the used up day of pollen is before the day it was collected.

data.name: ErrAmountTooLong
data.value: The amount is too long. Keep it under 80 characters.
data.comment: Error when the amount of pollen is longer than 80 characters.

data.name: PollenAgeToday
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, for today.

data.name: PollenAgeDays_One
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, exactly one day.

data.name: PollenAgeDays_Other
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, up to two weeks. {0} is the number of days.

data.name: PollenAgeWeeks_Other
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, in weeks. {0} is the number, always two or more.

data.name: PollenAgeMonths_Other
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, in months. {0} is the number, always two or more.

data.name: PollenAgeYears_Other
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, in years. {0} is the number, always two or more.

data.name: PollenCollected
data.comment: Line on pollen. {0} is how long ago, like 3 weeks ago.

data.name: KeptFreezer
data.comment: Where pollen is kept.

data.name: KeptFridge
data.comment: Where pollen is kept.

data.name: KeptRoom
data.comment: Where pollen is kept.

data.name: PollenAgeWeeks_One
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, exactly one week. Not reached today, kept so the pair is complete.

data.name: PollenAgeMonths_One
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, exactly one month. Not reached today, kept so the pair is complete.

data.name: PollenAgeYears_One
data.comment: How long ago pollen was collected, exactly one year. Not reached today, kept so the pair is complete.
